sub_sections.title: ➟ Cortana
sub_sections.description_text:
[i]Rally Point:[/i] [b]Alpha[/b]
[i]Note: Moa's 1 & 2 are the only ones that can [u]NOT[/u] be reached from rally point Bravo.[/i]
[table]
[tr]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 1[/b]
[previewimg=29163140;sizeOriginal,floatLeft;icon_alert_major.png][/previewimg]　[b][i]Impossible![/i][/b] Intro cutscene, located a long way from the start of the mission. No chance of getting this one, invisible barriers, maximum bullet range and zone unloading make this Moa impossible.


[previewicon=29301893;sizeThumb,inline;H3_Cortana_01.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 2[/b]
Head through the first cave to your right as you progress, it has a single blister above it. When you reach the upper level, turn left, and continue up to the exposed wall [i](pre-Flood infestation)[/i]. The Moa is on a panel laying next to this wall.[i](this all before you use the first 'porta', door)[/i]
[previewicon=29301894;sizeThumb,inline;H3_Cortana_02.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 3[/b]
Inside the abandoned Pelican, this is in the large room where you trigger the first Cortana moment.

[previewicon=29301895;sizeThumb,inline;H3_Cortana_03.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 4[/b]
When Cortana says [i]"A collection of lies, that's all I am, stolen thoughts and memories"[/i], look through the gaps in the wall, just before the next door.
[previewicon=29301896;sizeThumb,inline;H3_Cortana_04.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 5[/b]
In the Bridge [i](the room with a hidden terminal/Cortana moment and the Tilt skull)[/i], up high on a fungus ledge to the left.
[previewicon=29301897;sizeThumb,inline;H3_Cortana_05.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 6[/b]
As you leave the Bridge [i](the room with a hidden terminal/Cortana moment and the Tilt skull)[/i], look to your left.
[previewicon=29301898;sizeThumb,inline;H3_Cortana_06.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 7[/b]
In a hole in the wall, as you go up a long narrow corridor. Look for the 2 purple pillars, the hole is in the opposite wall of the far pillar.

[previewicon=29301899;sizeThumb,inline;H3_Cortana_07.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 8[/b]
In the last combat room before the reactor room, where the intended path has you spiral up counter-clockwise to the next door. Go up the first ramp, you find the Moa on a pedestal in the tunnel ahead.
[previewicon=29301900;sizeThumb,inline;H3_Cortana_08.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 9[/b]
In the Reactor room, on the reactor that explodes as you enter the room.
[previewicon=29301901;sizeThumb,inline;H3_Cortana_09.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

On the cliff, to the left of the exterior Control Room door.

On the third last pedestal, along the left wall, as you enter the corridors to the Control Room.

At the start of the second tunnel during the Warthog run, on a ledge, on the right side.
[previewicon=29301950;sizeThumb,inline;H3_Halo_08.jpg][/previewicon]

[td]
[b]Golden Moa 9[/b]
Between some rocks at the exit of the second tunnel, to the left of the ramp.
[previewicon=29301951;sizeThumb,inline;H3_Halo_09.jpg][/previewicon]

sub_sections.title: [b]Reach[/b]: 17ᵗʰ September 2026 Weekly Set
sub_sections.description_text:
[b]Winter Contingency[/b]
[i]Rally Point: [b]Alpha[/b][/i]
[i]Golden Moa [b]2[/b][/i] — Under the stairs to the basement of the barn, just after Jun says [i]“Boss, I see movement! Outside your structure!”[/i]
[previewimg=29163153;sizeFull,inline;Reach_WinterContingency_02.jpg][/previewimg]
⠀
[i]Golden Moa [b]3[/b][/i] — Inside the Hay Shed, just beyond the first waterfall, where Kat & Emile get an airlift to the relay outpost.
[previewimg=29163154;sizeFull,inline;Reach_WinterContingency_03.jpg][/previewimg]
⠀
[i]Rally Point: [b]Bravo[/b][/i]
[i]Golden Moa [b]4[/b][/i] — After crossing the second river, head south east to the broken bridge. The Golden Moa is on top of the second silo beside the bridge.
[previewimg=29163155;sizeFull,inline;Reach_WinterContingency_04.jpg][/previewimg]
⠀
[previewimg=29249451;sizeFull,inline;div02.png][/previewimg]

[i]Rally Point: [b]Alpha[/b][/i]
[i]Golden Moa [b]1[/b][/i] — At the south east end of the upper walkway, in Sword Base’s courtyard.
[previewimg=29250058;sizeFull,inline;Reach_ONISwordBase_01z.jpg][/previewimg]
⠀
[i]Rally Point: [b]Bravo[/b][/i]
[i]Golden Moa [b]2[/b][/i] — On the way to Airview Base, Anti-Air battery. The Golden Moa is on a rock next to the dirt road, as it reaches the cliff edge.
[previewimg=29163157;sizeFull,inline;Reach_ONISwordBase_02.jpg][/previewimg]
⠀
[i]Rally Point: [b]Charlie[/b][/i]
[i]Golden Moa [b]4[/b][/i] — On the first floor, in the Operations room, north side of Sword Base’s Atrium.
[previewimg=29163159;sizeFull,inline;Reach_ONISwordBase_04.jpg][/previewimg]
⠀
[previewimg=29249451;sizeFull,inline;div02.png][/previewimg]
[b]Nightfall[/b]
[i]Rally Point: [b]Alpha[/b][/i]
[i]Golden Moa [b]1[/b][/i] — Take the high ground at the first group of Covenant, the Golden Moa is behind the tree that is south west of the Camouflage pick-up.
[previewimg=29163161;sizeFull,inline;Reach_Nightfall_01.jpg][/previewimg]
⠀
[i]Rally Point: [b]Bravo[/b][/i]
[i]Golden Moa [b]2[/b][/i] — On top of a rock by the cliff walls, at the western end of the area with the two Guta.
[previewimg=29163162;sizeFull,inline;Reach_Nightfall_02.jpg][/previewimg]
⠀
[i]Rally Point: [b]Charlie[/b][/i]
[i]Golden Moa [b]4[/b][/i] — In the shower just past the lockers, west side of the spillway, at the Hydroelectric Plant.
[previewimg=29163164;sizeFull,inline;Reach_Nightfall_04.jpg][/previewimg]
⠀

sub_sections.title: ➟ Dawn
sub_sections.description_text:
[i]Rally Point:[/i] [b]Alpha[/b]
[table]
[tr]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 1[/b]
On the right side of Observation deck, this Golden Moa
is on the lower level behind some crates.
[previewicon=30174044;sizeThumb,inline;H4_Dawn_01.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

[i]Rally Point:[/i] [b]Bravo[/b]
[table]
[tr]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 2[/b]
After taking the elevator down a few levels you’ll reach a stairway, the Golden Moa is on top of some pipes in the corner.
[i]“That cruiser's shields are down. Assuming they don't raise them, that missile's going to be one heck of a surprise.” Cortana[/i]
[previewicon=30174045;sizeThumb,inline;H4_Dawn_02.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 3[/b]
In the doughnut room take the right path, the Golden Moa is on a ledge by a glowing yellow light.




[previewicon=30174046;sizeThumb,inline;H4_Dawn_03.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 4[/b]
Once you exit the airlock to the outer hull, look to the right, the Golden Moa is on a ledge nearby.



[previewicon=30174047;sizeThumb,inline;H4_Dawn_04.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 5[/b]
As you enter a passage with a few Grunts, a explosion in the ceiling with cause debris to collapse the floor, the Golden Moa is on the lower level to the right.
[i]“All but one of the grav generators just went dark.” Cortana[/i]
[previewicon=30174048;sizeThumb,inline;H4_Dawn_05.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 6[/b]
As you near the vehicle bay, you’ll reach a large room where the upper floor collapses, the Golden Moa is in the far right corner.
[previewicon=30174049;sizeThumb,inline;H4_Dawn_06.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

sub_sections.description_text:
[i]Rally Point:[/i] [b]Alpha[/b]
[table]
[tr]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 1[/b]
At the start of the level, the Golden Moa is among some rocks past the Mammoth.
[previewicon=30174080;sizeThumb,inline;H4_Reclaimer_01.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 2[/b]
Past Gypsy_Seven’s Pelican crash site, the Golden Moa is on a rock next to the waterfalls.
[previewicon=30174081;sizeThumb,inline;H4_Reclaimer_02.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 3[/b]
In the canyon with the 3 power sources generating a force field. The Golden Moa is on a rock near the closest power source.

[previewicon=30174082;sizeThumb,inline;H4_Reclaimer_03.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 4[/b]
After destroying the Lich, the Golden Moa is on a rock at the head of the 1st tributary (aka a stream).

[previewicon=30174085;sizeThumb,inline;H4_Reclaimer_05.jpg][/previewicon]

[td]
[b]Golden Moa 6[/b]
As you enter the Particle Cannon Control Room, the Golden Moa is in the corner to the right of the door.

[previewicon=30174086;sizeThumb,inline;H4_Reclaimer_06.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[/tr]

sub_sections.description_text:
[i]Rally Point:[/i] [b]Alpha[/b]
[table]
[tr]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 1[/b]
At the 1st IFF tag, the Golden Moa is over to the right on a tree root.

[previewicon=30174072;sizeThumb,inline;H4_Infinity_01.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 2[/b]
As you make your way down the hill from the 1st IFF tag, look to the left side, the Golden Moa is up on top of a large tree root.
[previewicon=30174073;sizeThumb,inline;H4_Infinity_02.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

[i]Rally Point:[/i] [b]Bravo[/b]
[table]
[tr]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 3[/b]
After rescuing a group of Marines head up the hill to a
sealed door, the Golden Moa is on a rock to the left of
the door.
[i]“The Marines got trapped trying to get through these
doors. Look for an interface.” Cortana[/i]
[previewicon=30174074;sizeThumb,inline;H4_Infinity_03.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

[i]Rally Point:[/i] [b]Charlie[/b]
[table]
[tr]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 4[/b]
As you make your way to Infinity [i](starboard hangar 2-19)[/i], you will pass multiple Covenant deployable lookout tower. Look to the right at the 4th lookout tower, the Golden Moa in on a rock under some debris.
[previewicon=30174075;sizeThumb,inline;H4_Infinity_04.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 5[/b]
After entering the maintenance causeway, you’ll find this Golden Moa up on a ledge past the 1st junction.

[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 6[/b]

[previewicon=30174077;sizeThumb,inline;H4_Infinity_06.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 7[/b]
On the outer hull of the Infinity, the Golden Moa is up on a ledge behind the left gun emplacement.


[previewicon=30174078;sizeThumb,inline;H4_Infinity_07.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

sub_sections.description_text:

[tr]
[td]

[td]
[b]Golden Moa 2[/b]

[tr]
[td]

[tr]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 5[/b]

[td]
[b]Golden Moa 10[/b]

sub_sections.description_text:
[table]
[tr]
[td]

[td]

sub_sections.title: ➟ The Truth and Reconciliation
sub_sections.description_text:
[table]
[tr]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 1[/b]
As you reach the 2nd Covenant encounter, you’ll find a Golden Moa around the corner to the right.
[i]"Stop. Motion tracker shows movement around the next bend" Cortana.[/i]


[previewicon=30092666;sizeThumb,inline;CE_TheTruthandReconciliation_01.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 2[/b]
At the 3rd Covenant encounter, take the suggested left path. The Golden Moa is behind a couple of boulders at the end of the path, near one of the Covenants stationary guns (aka Shade turret).
[i]"Covenant forces detected up ahead. The path up on the left should let us sneak up around" Cortana.[/i]
[previewicon=30092667;sizeThumb,inline;CE_TheTruthandReconciliation_02.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 3[/b]
This Golden Moa is past the grav lift, hidden behind the furthest rock spike.





[previewicon=30092668;sizeThumb,inline;CE_TheTruthandReconciliation_03.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 4[/b]
After completing belly fight, and leaving the Marines waiting for you to unlock a door. Follow the side passage, turning left just before you reach a dark grey pillar. The Golden Moa is next to the locked door, down the left passage.
[i]The Picture-in-Picture shows the side passage, up to the dark grey pillar.[/i]
[previewicon=30092669;sizeThumb,inline;CE_TheTruthandReconciliation_04.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 5[/b]
On the balcony of the cargo bay, you’ll find a Golden Moa hidden in the far corner under a crate.
[i]”Wait. That's the locked door down there…" Cortana.[/i]
[previewimg=29163141;sizeThumb,floatLeft;icon_alert_minor.png][/previewimg]　[i]You will probably need to use a Grenade /
　　Plasma Grenade to destroy this one.[/i]
[previewicon=30092670;sizeThumb,inline;CE_TheTruthandReconciliation_05.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 6[/b]
As you enter the hanger bay filled with crates, follow the wall to the right. The Golden Moa is behind a group of crates against the wall.
[i]The Picture-in-Picture shows the view looking in from above.[/i]
[previewicon=30092671;sizeThumb,inline;CE_TheTruthandReconciliation_06.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 7[/b]
When you reach the 3rd level of the hanger bay, turn left, you will find the Golden Moa in a nearby nook.
[previewicon=30092672;sizeThumb,inline;CE_TheTruthandReconciliation_07.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 8[/b]
This Golden Moa is in a nook, in the back left corner of the ship’s Command Center.
[previewicon=30092673;sizeThumb,inline;CE_TheTruthandReconciliation_08.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 9[/b]
In the brig, where you rescue Captain Keyes, the Golden Moa is in the 2nd last cell on the right.
[previewicon=30092674;sizeThumb,inline;CE_TheTruthandReconciliation_09.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

sub_sections.title: ➟ The Silent Cartographer
sub_sections.description_text:
[table]
[tr]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 1[/b]
After exiting the Pelican make your way towards the nearby structure. On the far side of the outer pillar, you’ll find this Golden Moa on top of a ledge about half way up.
[previewicon=30092675;sizeThumb,inline;CE_TheSilentCartographer_01.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 2[/b]
After acquiring the Warthog from Foehammer, continue round the island anti-clockwise to the next area. The Golden Moa can be found on a ledge in the exposed structure, where part of the cliff has collapsed.
[previewicon=30092676;sizeThumb,inline;CE_TheSilentCartographer_02.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 3[/b]
After acquiring the Warthog from Foehammer, follow the shoreline round the island anti-clockwise to the next area. Where the water meets the cliffs, the Golden Moa will be in the shallows beside some rocks.
[previewicon=30092677;sizeThumb,inline;CE_TheSilentCartographer_03.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 4[/b]
The Golden Moa is beneath the main facilities entrance.
[i]”There, in the cliff wall; I'll bet the Silent Cartographer is somewhere inside that facility” Cortana.[/i]
[previewicon=30092678;sizeThumb,inline;CE_TheSilentCartographer_04.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 5[/b]
After entering the main facility (past the locked door), continue down 1 level, as you reach this level the Golden Moa is on the other side of the wall to your right.
Alternatively after passing through the locked door, head for the Shafted cutscene, from here you can see and shoot the Golden Moa.
[previewicon=30092679;sizeThumb,inline;CE_TheSilentCartographer_05.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 6[/b]
This Golden Moa is at the back of the room, on the lowest level of the main facility. Playing through the main facility as the developers intended, you’ll be able to shoot this Golden Moa by looking down a shaft just past the Hunters.


[previewicon=30092680;sizeThumb,inline;CE_TheSilentCartographer_06.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

sub_sections.description_text:

[td]
[b]Golden Moa 7[/b]

[previewicon=30092664;sizeThumb,inline;CE_Halo_07.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 8[/b]
At the head of the river, the Golden Moa is in the water next to the waterfall.

[previewicon=30092665;sizeThumb,inline;CE_Halo_08.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]

[h3]What's the point of collecting these?[/h3]
[previewimg=29251416;sizeThumb,floatRight;challenge_plaque.png][/previewimg]Each week there is a PvE Challenge for destroying three Golden Moa's (Statues), "Eye Spy", which awards one Spartan Point and 100,000 XP. The missions & locations change each week, check the Challenge Hub for more info.


[h3]What if the Covenant destroy the Golden Moa's, will they still count?[/h3]
Yes, those will count. As will scripted explosions, because the game doesn't appear to track how the Golden Moa was destroyed, just if its been destroyed. Although I haven't tested this in co-op.


[h3]Each week, how many Golden Moa's are there in each mission?[/h3]
Most missions will have three Golden Moa's. There are exceptions mostly due to there not being enough spawn locations in some missions. The following list notes all missions known to be an exception:
[b]Reach[/b]
⠀➟ Winter Contingency⠀[i](only two locations some weeks)[/i]
⠀➟ Lone Wolf⠀[i](limited to two locations)[/i]
[b]Combat Evolved[/b]
⠀➟ Halo⠀[i](two to four locations some weeks)[/i]
⠀➟ 343 Guilty Spark⠀[i](only two locations most weeks)[/i]
[b]Halo 2[/b]
⠀➟ Metropolis⠀[i](two to four locations some weeks)[/i]
⠀➟ High Charity⠀[i](only two locations some weeks)[/i]
[b]Halo 3[/b]
⠀➟ Cortana⠀[i](only two locations most weeks)[/i]
[b]ODST[/b]
⠀➟ Kizingo Boulevard⠀[i](limited to two locations)[/i]
⠀➟ ONI Alpha Site⠀[i](limited to  one location)[/i]
⠀➟ NMPD HQ⠀[i](limited to  one location)[/i]
⠀➟ Kikowani Station⠀[i](limited to two locations)[/i]
⠀➟ Mombasa Streets⠀[i](only two locations most weeks)[/i]
[b]Halo 4[/b]
⠀➟ Composer⠀[i](four locations some weeks)[/i]


[h3]What do the Grey, Gold & Red icons in the screenshots mean?[/h3]
They indicate the [i]Rally Points[/i] in each mission, reading left to right, and whether or not you'll be able to collect the Golden Moa from the corresponding rally point.

[previewimg=29163144;sizeOriginal,floatLeft;icon_rally_grey.png][/previewimg][b]Grey: [/b]A rally point where the Golden Moa [u]isn't[/u] in this part of the mission, or that you can [u]not[/u] backtrack from this rally point.

[previewimg=29163143;sizeOriginal,floatLeft;icon_rally_gold.png][/previewimg][b]Gold: [/b]A rally point where the Golden Moa first appears in the mission, or that you can backtrack from this rally point.

[previewimg=29163145;sizeOriginal,floatLeft;icon_rally_red.png][/previewimg][b]Red: [/b]A rally point where the Golden Moa first appears, but it's [u]impossible[/u], or to difficult to collect.


[h3]Do you check every possible location each week, or just the predicted locations?[/h3]
Just the predicted locations, as the sequence hasn't change in quite awhile. In the past I would check all possible locations, but I've opted to stop the exhaustive search due to a lack of motivation.


[h3]None of the Golden Moa's are showing up in-game, What should I do?[/h3]
Sometimes this can occur, and I assume it's due to a bad sync with the servers.
[list]Some possible solutions are:
[*] Restart Halo: MCC
[*] Restart your computer
[/list]
On rare occasions you'll need to wait a day or two.

[b]Golden Moa 6[/b]
At the bottom of the waterfall, at the first Phantom drop off.
[previewicon=29301790;sizeThumb,inline;H3_Sierra117_06.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 7[/b]
Between the first 2 enemy encounters, turn around after dropping down. [i](this is [u]NOT[/u] near the first Cortana moment)[/i]
[previewicon=29301791;sizeThumb,inline;H3_Sierra117_07.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 8[/b]
In the area where you encounter the first sleeping Grunts, look in a tree to the far right. It's beside the path you'll take to the next area.
[previewicon=29301792;sizeThumb,inline;H3_Sierra117_08.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 9[/b]
After the Brute interrogating a Marine on a log, go across the log, and into the cave to the left.
[previewicon=29301793;sizeThumb,inline;H3_Sierra117_09.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 10[/b]
On top of the pipe that's just after the Brute interrogating a Marine.
[previewicon=29301794;sizeThumb,inline;H3_Sierra117_10.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

[i]Rally Point:[/i] [b]Bravo[/b]
[table]
[tr]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 11[/b]
Under the ramp of the first pump house, where the Banshees shoot down the EVAC Pelicans.
[previewimg=29163141;sizeThumb,floatLeft;icon_alert_minor.png][/previewimg]　[i]Bugged, does [u]NOT[/u] count most weeks.[/i]
[previewicon=29301795;sizeThumb,inline;H3_Sierra117_11.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 12[/b]
In a large pipe, on the side of the large pump station.


[previewicon=29301796;sizeThumb,inline;H3_Sierra117_12.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

[i]Rally Point:[/i] [b]Charlie[/b]
[table]
[tr]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 13[/b]
On top of the cliff/rock to your left as you reach the area where Sgt. Johnson's Pelican went down.


[previewicon=29301797;sizeThumb,inline;H3_Sierra117_13.jpg][/previewicon]

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 [/td]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 14[/b]
In the river, well out of sight. To line this one up, grab a Sniper Rifle [i](UNSC)[/i], and stand on the crashed Pelican. Position yourself against the landing gear by the cargo door.
[previewicon=29301798;sizeThumb,inline;H3_Sierra117_14.jpg][/previewicon]
Aim at the lower portion of the scratches in front of you, and zoom in.
[previewicon=29301799;sizeThumb,inline;H3_Sierra117_14b.jpg][/previewicon]
Locate the wonky X [i](reference point)[/i], and position your crosshair on the end of the right most point of the X. Raise your aim until the X's right most point is between the 3ᴿᴰ and 5ᵀᴴ [i]Compensation Points[/i]. Then crouch and shoot.
[previewicon=29301800;sizeThumb,inline;H3_Sierra117_14c.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 15[/b]
On top of the cliff, behind the bushes, in the area where Sgt. Johnson's Pelican went down. Best vantage point is between the large concrete pipe and cliff, located up the hill from the crashed Pelican. 
[previewicon=29301801;sizeThumb,inline;H3_Sierra117_15.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 16[/b]
On a pipe just above the far side of the river, next to the dam wall.


[previewicon=29301802;sizeThumb,inline;H3_Sierra117_16.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 17[/b]
Above the cave you entered the final area through. You can see it through the leaves, when standing next to the No Fishing\No Swimming sign on the Dam Wall.
[previewicon=29301803;sizeThumb,inline;H3_Sierra117_17.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[/tr]

sub_sections.title: ➟ The Great Journey
sub_sections.description_text:
[table]
[tr]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 1[/b]
Make your way to the base of the structure that the Scarab is stationed at. The Golden Moa is atop the ledge, on the second support structure, counting left the right.
[previewicon=32720827;sizeThumb,inline;H2_TheGreatJourney_01.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 2[/b]
In the two-level room with the first Shade Turret for the mission, where a group of Brutes await your arrival. You’ll find the Golden Moa is atop the ledge, above the door you entered through.
[previewicon=32720828;sizeThumb,inline;H2_TheGreatJourney_02.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 3[/b]
On the bridge defended by Jackals & Drones. Look to the right of the door you enter through, the Golden Moa is on top of the lower ledge, on the nearest pillar.

[previewicon=32720829;sizeThumb,inline;H2_TheGreatJourney_03.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 4[/b]
Once you reach the outer platform, by the Scarab, where the Brutes are about to kill some Marines. The Golden Moa is on the ledge above the door you just came through.
[previewicon=32720830;sizeThumb,inline;H2_TheGreatJourney_04.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 5[/b]
[i]Delusions and Grandeur.[/i]
As you make your way through the charred entry to the Control Room, you’ll reach the door to the next room. The Golden Moa is to the right of the door, beneath some rubble.
[previewicon=32720831;sizeThumb,inline;H2_TheGreatJourney_05.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

sub_sections.title: ➟ High Charity
sub_sections.description_text:
[table]
[tr]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 1[/b]
[i]Please, Make Yourself at Home.[/i]
After making your way across the large chamber, head down the passage into a dark straight corridor. Once inside turn right, the Golden Moa is in the corner on the raised path.
[previewicon=32720823;sizeThumb,inline;H2_HighCharity_01.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 2[/b]
In the first garden room, head up to the large window, the Golden Moa is behind a rock at the right end of the window.
[i]”The parasite did not defeat the Forerunners...and it shall not defeat us.” Prophet of Truth[/i]
[previewicon=32720824;sizeThumb,inline;H2_HighCharity_02.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 3[/b]
In the second garden room, head up to the broken window, the Golden Moa is in the far left corner by the window.
[i]”The security systems in this part of the tower are particularly robust.” Cortana[/i]
[previewicon=32720825;sizeThumb,inline;H2_HighCharity_03.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 4[/b]
[previewimg=29163140;sizeOriginal,floatLeft;icon_alert_major.png][/previewimg]　[b][i]Impossible?[/i][/b] This Golden Moa is in a separate area of the Prophet Hierarch's private quarters, this area is not used during gameplay.


[previewicon=32720826;sizeThumb,inline;H2_HighCharity_04.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

sub_sections.title: ➟ Uprising
sub_sections.description_text:
[table]
[tr]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 1[/b]
In the large cave, look for the far pillar, on the outer edge of the second circular platform. The Golden Moa is atop a light on the back of the pillar.

[previewicon=32720819;sizeThumb,inline;H2_Uprising_01.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 2[/b]
After passing though a passage with Elite corpses you’ll reach a two-level room with a Brute manning a Shade Turret, the Golden Moa is on the ledge above the door you entered through.
[previewicon=32720820;sizeThumb,inline;H2_Uprising_02.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 3[/b]
Once you reach the pool of water at the head of the stream, the Golden Moa is in the pool beside the log.




[previewicon=32720821;sizeThumb,inline;H2_Uprising_03.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 4[/b]
[i]Fight Club.[/i]
In the basin at the end of the stream, take the ramp up to the circular structure, the Golden Moa is behind the first pillar.
[i]The Picture-in-Picture is looking from the ramp, towards the middle of the basin.[/i]
[previewicon=32720822;sizeThumb,inline;H2_Uprising_04.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

sub_sections.title: ➟ Regret
sub_sections.description_text:
[table]
[tr]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 1[/b]
At the start of the mission, the Golden Moa is atop the wall behind you. You’ll want to head up the ramp to the upper level to be able to see this one.
[previewicon=32720796;sizeThumb,inline;H2_Regret_01.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 2[/b]
After making your way outside the temple, follow the path around towards the next connected structure. The Golden Moa is on the bridge, beneath the raised path.
[previewicon=32720797;sizeThumb,inline;H2_Regret_02.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 3[/b]
At the start of the mission, after crossing the bridge to the first connected structure, you’ll find the Golden Moa on a balcony to the left.
[previewicon=32720798;sizeThumb,inline;H2_Regret_03.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 4[/b]
Once inside the first tower, follow the ramps up to the balcony above the elevator shaft. The Golden Moa will be to you right as you head outside.
[previewicon=32720799;sizeThumb,inline;H2_Regret_04.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 5[/b]
At the start of the submerged section, you’ll enter a corridor patrolled by Grunts [i](not to be confused with the flooded corridor patrolled by cloaked Covenant)[/i]. The Golden Moa is at the far end of the corridor, beneath the ramp.
[previewicon=32720800;sizeThumb,inline;H2_Regret_05.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 6[/b]
Once you reach the main temple, head up the ramp to the entry, but don’t go inside just yet. Follow the balcony round to the right, the Golden Moa is just around the corner of the building.

[previewicon=32720801;sizeThumb,inline;H2_Regret_06.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

sub_sections.title: ➟ Delta Halo
sub_sections.description_text:
[table]
[tr]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 1[/b]
In front of the main ruined structure at the start of the mission, the Golden Moa is up on a ledge at the back of the small structure to the left.
[previewicon=32720791;sizeThumb,inline;H2_DeltaHalo_01.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 2[/b]
Make your way to the far side of the structure that controls the bridge, the Golden Moa is on top of the lower guide track for the bridge.
[previewicon=32720792;sizeThumb,inline;H2_DeltaHalo_02.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 3[/b]
After crossing the bridge, you will enter a tunnel with a split path, take the lower path towards the waterfall. The Golden Moa will be in the alcove to your left, where you can also find a Ghost.



[previewicon=32720793;sizeThumb,inline;H2_DeltaHalo_03.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 4[/b]
As you come to the end of the winding ruins, you’ll reach an open are with a central structure that the Covenant are pouring out of. Take the left path, up a ramp, towards the lake. The Golden Moa will be on the furthest platform, over hanging the lake.
[i]“Careful. We're coming up to another structure.” Cortana or Marine[/i]
[previewicon=32720794;sizeThumb,inline;H2_DeltaHalo_04.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 5[/b]
[i]Off the Rock, Through the Bush, Nothing But Jackal.[/i]
Once you reach the top of the waterfall, drop down into the water below, the Golden Moa is in a small cave to the right as you follow the creek.
[previewicon=32720795;sizeThumb,inline;H2_DeltaHalo_05.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

sub_sections.title: ➟ The Oracle
sub_sections.description_text:
[table]
[tr]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 1[/b]
At the start of the mission, this Golden Moa is on top of the large tank holding small, floating, fleshy lifeforms.
[previewicon=32720786;sizeThumb,inline;H2_TheOracle_01.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 2[/b]
Once on the elevator platform, peer over the right side. The Golden Moa is on a ledge at back of the room, about halfway down.
[previewicon=33995278;sizeThumb,inline;H2_TheOracle_02z.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 3[/b]
As you enter the second lab, before dropping down, go towards the left locked door. The Golden Moa is in the corner next to the locked door, beside a set of wash stations.
[previewicon=33995279;sizeThumb,inline;H2_TheOracle_03z.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 4[/b]
As you enter the second lab, before dropping down, go towards the right locked door. The Golden Moa is beside the final pillar, next to the locked door.

[previewicon=33995280;sizeThumb,inline;H2_TheOracle_04z.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

sub_sections.title: ➟ The Arbiter
sub_sections.description_text:
[table]
[tr]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 1[/b]
After entering the Forerunner facility through the airlock, look to the left, the Golden Moa is on a ledge above a nearby light.
[previewicon=32720777;sizeThumb,inline;H2_TheArbiter_01.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 2[/b]
As you descend into the hangar, the Golden Moa will be up on a ledge next to the elevator [i](right side of the elevator, when facing the hangar door)[/i].
[previewicon=32720778;sizeThumb,inline;H2_TheArbiter_02.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 3[/b]
After leaving the hangar, follow the passageway down to the next room. Pass by the ramp ahead, the Golden Moa will be beneath the second ramp to your left. [i](this is before you cross the blue conveyor belts)[/i]
[previewicon=32720779;sizeThumb,inline;H2_TheArbiter_03.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 4[/b]
This Golden Moa just inside the curved room, it will be on up on a ledge to the right as you enter.


[previewicon=32720780;sizeThumb,inline;H2_TheArbiter_04.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 5[/b]
[i]To the Hunt.[/i]
Once you head outside to the Banshees, the Golden Moa will be on a pillar left of the window.
[previewicon=32720781;sizeThumb,inline;H2_TheArbiter_05.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

sub_sections.title: ➟ Metropolis
sub_sections.description_text:
[table]
[tr]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 1[/b]
As you pass the hole in the bridge, you’ll find the Golden Moa just beyond the right cable.

[previewicon=32720772;sizeThumb,inline;H2_Metropolis_01.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 2[/b]
After passing the toll booths on the far side of the bridge, this Golden Moa will be up the left ramp by a roller door.
[previewicon=32720773;sizeThumb,inline;H2_Metropolis_02.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 3[/b]
As you make your way through the tunnel, a Warthog will appear from a side road. Head up the side road, the Golden Moa is in the corner by the roller door.
[previewicon=32720774;sizeThumb,inline;H2_Metropolis_03.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 4[/b]
As you make your way through the park, you’ll reach an area with a Wraith. The Golden Moa will be in the pool of water, by the right drain.
[previewicon=32720775;sizeThumb,inline;H2_Metropolis_04.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 5[/b]
At the Marine Command Post, take the road to the left, the Golden Moa is just above the entrance of the far building [i](Hannibal building according to the remaster)[/i].
[previewicon=32720776;sizeThumb,inline;H2_Metropolis_05.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

sub_sections.title: ➟ Outskirts
sub_sections.description_text:
[table]
[tr]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 1[/b]
After entering the courtyard, follow the street past the red Truck. The Golden Moa is by the proceeding intersection.
[i]“More on the street, left side!” Sgt. Johnson[/i]

[previewicon=32720764;sizeThumb,inline;H2_Outskirts_01.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 2[/b]
At the far end of Sniper Alley, the Golden Moa is around the corner on top of an awning.
[previewicon=29163141;sizeOriginal,inline;icon_alert_minor.png][/previewicon]　Not yet sure which triggers must be hit to get this
　　one to spawn, but playing through the mission as
　　the Dev's intended usually works.
[previewicon=32720765;sizeThumb,inline;H2_Outskirts_02.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 3[/b]
After going through Hotel Zanzibar, take a right and follow the road all the way to the end. The Golden Moa is behind the dumpster, by the locked gates.

[previewicon=32720766;sizeThumb,inline;H2_Outskirts_03.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 4[/b]
Follow the beach until you reach the first deployed Covenant artillery [i](Type-48 Artillery Platform, aka “Weevil”)[/i]. The Golden Moa is past the Covenant Artillery, between two large pipes.
[previewicon=32720767;sizeThumb,inline;H2_Outskirts_04.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 5[/b]
In the final beach area before the tunnel, the Golden Moa is behind some rocks in the gap between the city wall and a large structure.
[i]“Chief, the carrier just launched a wave of pods. They're inbound on your position!” Commander Miranda Keyes[/i]
[previewicon=32720768;sizeThumb,inline;H2_Outskirts_05.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 6[/b]
As you reach the final Covenant blockade in the tunnel, sector C4. The Golden Moa is on the left side of the tunnel, on the walkway beside the locked gate.



[previewicon=32720769;sizeThumb,inline;H2_Outskirts_06.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

sub_sections.title: ➟ Midnight
sub_sections.description_text:
[i]Rally Point:[/i] [b]Bravo[/b]
[table]
[tr]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 1[/b]
As you make your way past the 1st group of Promethean’s [i](Watchers & Focus Turrets)[/i]. The Golden Moa is up on a ledge to the left, just before the next door.
[previewicon=30174107;sizeThumb,inline;H4_Midnight_01.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 2[/b]
After going through a few doorways, Cortana will say [i]”I recommend entering the doorway to your left."[/i] The Golden Moa is on the floor, in the far right corner of the room.
[previewicon=30174108;sizeThumb,inline;H4_Midnight_02.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 3[/b]
After going through the 1st portal, the Golden Moa is up on a ledge behind you.


[previewicon=30174109;sizeThumb,inline;H4_Midnight_03.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 4[/b]
After traveling through a few portals, you’ll enter a T-shaped room where you will need to defend your position. The Golden Moa is up on top of a pillar, just past where the Promethean Knight spawns in.
[previewicon=30174110;sizeThumb,inline;H4_Midnight_04.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

[i]Rally Point:[/i] [b]Charlie[/b]
[table]
[tr]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 5[/b]
In the final arena, before you find Cortana another terminal. The Golden Moa is in the corner to the right as you drop down to a lower level.
[previewicon=30174111;sizeThumb,inline;H4_Midnight_05.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 6[/b]
In the final arena, head to the left beam platform. The Golden Moa is on the 2nd level, behind the ramps to the 3rd level.
[previewicon=30174112;sizeThumb,inline;H4_Midnight_06.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 7[/b]
In the final arena, head to the right beam platform. The Golden Moa is inside the side passage, on the 2nd level of this platform.
[previewicon=30174113;sizeThumb,inline;H4_Midnight_07.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

sub_sections.title: ➟ Composer
sub_sections.description_text:
[i]Rally Point:[/i] [b]Alpha[/b]
[table]
[tr]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 1[/b]
As you enter Hanger Bay 7, the Golden Moa is just round the corner to the left from the entrance.
[previewicon=30174099;sizeThumb,inline;H4_Composer_01.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 2[/b]
At the back of Hanger Bay 7, the Golden Moa is on the 2nd level platform by the Maintenance Shed’s left door.
[previewicon=30174100;sizeThumb,inline;H4_Composer_02.jpg][/previewicon]

sub_sections.title: ➟ Keyes
sub_sections.description_text:
[table]
[tr]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 1[/b]
At the start of the mission turn around, the Golden Moa is on top of a crate behind the damaged wall.
[i](You can get this one later on is the mission)[/i]

[previewicon=30092715;sizeThumb,inline;CE_Keyes_01.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 2[/b]
After dropping down into the pool of coolant, make your way through the fighting to a much smaller pool of coolant. The Golden Moa is hidden in the stream of coolant.
[previewicon=30092716;sizeThumb,inline;CE_Keyes_02.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 3[/b]
This Golden Moa is on a ledge  above you as you make your way through the narrow pass with the falling Flood Carrier Forms. [i](If you reach the Sniper Rifle/Hunters, then you’ve gone to far)[/i]


[previewicon=33995277;sizeThumb,inline;CE_Keyes_03z.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 4[/b]
After passing through the cargo bay, you’ll enter a passage way with Flood guarding a hole in the floor. The Golden Moa is to the left of the hole, shoot it before dropping down!
[i]”Look, in the corners. The Flood are gathering bodies here.” Cortana[/i]
[previewicon=30092718;sizeThumb,inline;CE_Keyes_04.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 5[/b]
On the 2nd level of the shuttle bay [i](aka hanger bay)[/i], the Golden Moa is in a nook near center platform.
[i](When you first enter the hanger bay you will already be on the 2nd floor)[/i]


[previewicon=30092719;sizeThumb,inline;CE_Keyes_05.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 6[/b]
After crossing the shuttle bay [i](aka hanger bay)[/i], enter the passage up to the 3rd level. The Golden Moa is beside the locked door to the left of the Flood, just past the 1st group of Grunts.
[i](Be careful that you don’t accidentally cause a Flood Carrier Form to explode near this one)[/i]
[previewicon=30092720;sizeThumb,inline;CE_Keyes_06.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 7[/b]
At the back of the ships Control Room [i](aka Command Center)[/i], the Golden Moa is behind the left pillar.
[previewicon=30092721;sizeThumb,inline;CE_Keyes_07.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

sub_sections.title: ➟ Two Betrayals
sub_sections.description_text:
[table]
[tr]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 1[/b]
Once you reach the chasm floor outside Control Room, the Golden Moa is under the protruding section of the Control Room structure.



[previewicon=30092702;sizeThumb,inline;CE_TwoBetrayals_01.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 2[/b]
After crossing the 1st bridge in the 2nd chasm, the next octagonal room will contain the Golden Moa [i](this room contains a large raised structure in the middle)[/i]. As you enter the room follow the outer perimeter anti-clockwise [i](go left)[/i], the Golden Moa is on top of a platform that extends into the center of the room.
[previewicon=30092703;sizeThumb,inline;CE_TwoBetrayals_02.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 3[/b]
After the elevator, you’ll reach another octagonal room. As you enter the room follow the outer perimeter anti-clockwise [i](go left)[/i], the Golden Moa is in the corner beside a protruding box like structure.
[previewicon=30092705;sizeThumb,inline;CE_TwoBetrayals_03.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 4[/b]
In the 2nd chasm, this Golden Moa can be found on top of the far wall between the large pipes.


[previewicon=30092706;sizeThumb,inline;CE_TwoBetrayals_04.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 5[/b]
In the 2nd chasm beneath the large pipes are two passages, the Golden Moa is at the end of the far passage.
[previewicon=30092707;sizeThumb,inline;CE_TwoBetrayals_05.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 6[/b]
In the octagonal room containing the 2nd phase pulse generator, the Golden Moa is the nearest tube to the right of the pulse generator.
[previewicon=30092708;sizeThumb,inline;CE_TwoBetrayals_06.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 7[/b]
In the octagonal room containing the unused phase pulse generator [i](in the same chasm as the 2nd phase pulse generator)[/i], the Golden Moa is in the far right tube.
[previewimg=29163140;sizeThumb,floatLeft;icon_alert_major.png][/previewimg]　[i]To reach this area, you will need to be able to
　　glitch through a locked door. I'll add a guide for
　　this soon, No ETA. For now just search [b]‘Halo CE
　　Banshee teleport tutorials’[/b] if you’re keen to get to
　　this Golden Moa.[/i]
[previewicon=30092709;sizeThumb,inline;CE_TwoBetrayals_07.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 8[/b]
In the cavern, the Golden Moa is on top of the nearest pipe next to the far right side of the bridge.







[previewicon=30092710;sizeThumb,inline;CE_TwoBetrayals_08.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 9[/b]
[i]Final Run.[/i]
As you reach the top of the ramp, leading into the final chasm, turnaround. The Golden Moa is beside a rock and the cliff face, on the left side of the tunnel entrance.
[previewicon=30092711;sizeThumb,inline;CE_TwoBetrayals_09.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 10[/b]
In the final section of the last chasm, the Golden Moa is beside a tree on the left side.



[previewicon=30092712;sizeThumb,inline;CE_TwoBetrayals_10.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 11[/b]
In the room with the final phase pulse generator. As you enter the room follow the outer perimeter anti-clockwise [i](go left)[/i], the Golden Moa is on top of a the 1st large pipe overhead.
[previewicon=30092713;sizeThumb,inline;CE_TwoBetrayals_11.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

sub_sections.title: [b]Halo 2[/b]
sub_sections.description_text: [previewicon=29163141;sizeOriginal,inline;icon_alert_minor.png][/previewicon]　Golden Moas in Halo 2 require switching to, or play with, original graphics.

sub_sections.title: ➟ Cairo Station
sub_sections.description_text:
[table]
[tr]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 1[/b]
This Golden Moa is at the start of the mission between the Communications booths, hidden behind the trash can.

[previewicon=32720755;sizeThumb,inline;H2_CairoStation_01.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 2[/b]
In the corridor after clearing the first Covenant assault [i](in Recreation R.01)[/i], take a left towards the locked door. The Golden Moa is in the corner beside the small fire.
[previewicon=32720756;sizeThumb,inline;H2_CairoStation_02.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 3[/b]
As you enter the MAC Storage room, via the right door from Hanger Bay A-02. The Golden Moa is on top of the central storage shelf.
[I]“Then they sure as hell brought one here.
Chief, find it.” Lord Hood[/i]
[previewicon=32720757;sizeThumb,inline;H2_CairoStation_03.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 4[/b]
This Golden Moa is on top of the Container Crane in Portside Shipping.



[previewicon=32720758;sizeThumb,inline;H2_CairoStation_04.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 5[/b]
As you make your way through the second space walk, the Golden Moa is on a ledge to the right just beyond the moving platform [i](MAC’s recoil arm)[/i].
[previewicon=32720759;sizeThumb,inline;H2_CairoStation_05.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

sub_sections.title: ➟ Exodus
sub_sections.description_text:
[i]Rally Point:[/i] [b]Alpha[/b]
[table]
[tr]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 1[/b]
After passing though the automatic doors, into the Civic Center, the Golden Moa is in the garden bed on the north side of the stairs.
[previewimg=29163175;sizeThumb,floatLeft;Reach_Exodus_01.jpg][/previewimg]
[/td]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 2[/b]
The Golden Moa is beside the elevators in the Housing building lobby, just before the suicide Grunts.

[previewimg=29163176;sizeThumb,floatLeft;Reach_Exodus_02.jpg][/previewimg]
[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 3[/b]
Inside the first maintenance storage room that is below the lobby.


[previewimg=29163177;sizeThumb,floatLeft;Reach_Exodus_03.jpg][/previewimg]
[/td]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 4[/b]
After passing through the Housing building/maintenance, the Golden Moa is in the garden bed above the stairs to the eastern World Cuisine stall.
[i](Just before you reach the 1st Brute attacking civilians)[/i]
[previewimg=29163178;sizeThumb,floatLeft;Reach_Exodus_04.jpg][/previewimg]
[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

[i]Rally Point:[/i] [b]Bravo[/b]
[table]
[tr]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 5[/b]
The Golden Moa is beside the elevator, after taking it
down to the Cargo Port, Traxus Tower.
[previewimg=29163179;sizeThumb,floatLeft;Reach_Exodus_05.jpg][/previewimg]
[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

sub_sections.title: ➟ Long Night of Solace
sub_sections.description_text:
[i]Rally Point:[/i] [b]Alpha[/b]
[table]
[tr]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 1[/b]
Beside a group of jagged rocks, at the waters edge, as you reach the path up to the Sabre Launch Facility.



[previewimg=29163172;sizeThumb,floatLeft;Reach_LongNightofSolace_01.jpg][/previewimg]
[/td]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 2[/b]
On top of the outer building, that overlooks the dock. This is just below the hole in the Sabre Launch Facility.
[previewimg=29163141;sizeOriginal,floatLeft;icon_alert_minor.png][/previewimg]       [i]On rare occasions this Golden Moa could be
　　knocked over or even destroyed by debris from the
　　Seraph fighter crashing into the Launch Facility.[/i]
[previewimg=29163173;sizeThumb,floatLeft;Reach_LongNightofSolace_02.jpg][/previewimg]
[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 3[/b]
On top the the western structure by the Sabre, the Golden Moa is beside the light tower on it’s roof.
[previewimg=29163174;sizeThumb,floatLeft;Reach_LongNightofSolace_03.jpg][/previewimg]
[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

sub_sections.title: ➟ Tip of the Spear
sub_sections.description_text:
[i]Rally Point:[/i] [b]Alpha[/b]
[table]
[tr]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 1[/b]
The Golden Moa is between 2 trees on the cliff edge, south east of the 1st Covenant Anti-Aircraft Cannon.


[previewimg=29163166;sizeThumb,floatLeft;Reach_TipoftheSpear_01.jpg][/previewimg]
[/td]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 2[/b]
After destroying the 1st Anti-Aircraft Cannon and crossing the bridge, the Golden Moa will be on a rock, in the north face of the canyon walls. This is just after rounding the corner, at the start of the broken road.
[previewimg=29163167;sizeThumb,floatLeft;Reach_TipoftheSpear_02.jpg][/previewimg]
[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

[i]Rally Point:[/i] [b]Bravo[/b]
[table]
[tr]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 3[/b]
On the BXR Mining Facilities 1st building, the Golden Moa is on top of the awning, above the facilities door [i](not to be confused with the facilities hole on the 2nd building)[/i].
[previewimg=29250059;sizeThumb,floatLeft;Reach_TipoftheSpear_03z.jpg][/previewimg]
[/td]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 4[/b]
Beneath the walkway that leads up into the BXR Mining Facility, the Golden Moa is by the south east wall overlooking the dam.

[previewimg=29250060;sizeThumb,floatLeft;Reach_TipoftheSpear_04z.jpg][/previewimg]
[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 5[/b]
South of the 2nd Anti-Aircraft Cannon, the Golden Moa is on top of the concrete footing at the north east end of the broken bridge.
[previewimg=29163170;sizeThumb,floatLeft;Reach_TipoftheSpear_05.jpg][/previewimg]
[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

sub_sections.title: ➟ Gravemind
sub_sections.description_text:
[table]
[tr]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 1[/b]
In the Council Chamber, as you make your way to the door. The Golden Moa is along the wall, beside the last passage door to your left.
[previewicon=32720813;sizeThumb,inline;H2_Gravemind_01.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 2[/b]
Once you reach the first outside area, where you’re greeted by one or two Brute Honor Guards. The Golden Moa is along the wall to your right, near the alien plant.
[previewicon=32720814;sizeThumb,inline;H2_Gravemind_02.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 3[/b]
Inside the brig on the middle level of the detention block, the Golden Moa is in the second cell to the right.
[i]“Chief, come to the middle level…” Cortana[/i]
[previewicon=32720815;sizeThumb,inline;H2_Gravemind_03.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 4[/b]
Before crossing the first gravity bridge. Look to the left of the door you just came through, this Golden Moa is hiding just around the corner.
[previewicon=32720816;sizeThumb,inline;H2_Gravemind_04.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 5[/b]
In the second set of hanging gardens, between gravity bridges three and four, the Golden Moa is behind a rock in the far left garden.
[i]”I have listened to the Oracle, and it confirmed our deepest hope. The Great Journey begins with Halo.” Prophet of Truth[/i]
[previewicon=32720817;sizeThumb,inline;H2_Gravemind_05.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 6[/b]
Once you reach the bridge to the Mausoleum, turn around and face the door you just came through, the Golden Moa is up on a ledge to the right of the door.
[i]”If we're going to catch Truth, we'll need to take a shortcut…” Cortana[/i]

[previewicon=32720818;sizeThumb,inline;H2_Gravemind_06.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

sub_sections.title: ➟ Quarantine Zone
sub_sections.description_text:
[table]
[tr]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 1[/b]
At the back of the large chamber, beneath the windows. Look for the Golden Moa on a lit ledge, left side of the exit.
[previewicon=32720809;sizeThumb,inline;H2_QuarantineZone_01.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 2[/b]
As you make your way around the upper level of the courtyard, the Golden Moa is atop the second roof structure, just before the ramp down.
[previewicon=32720810;sizeThumb,inline;H2_QuarantineZone_02.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 3[/b]
As you reach the clearing in the middle of the crashed Sentinel manufacturing facility, the Golden Moa is next to a fire atop the soil formation, that’s left of the smoldering spikes.
[previewicon=32720811;sizeThumb,inline;H2_QuarantineZone_03.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 4[/b]
In the valley, shortly after leaving the crashed Sentinel manufacturing facility. The Golden Moa is on a ledge on the far side of the chasm, just before the second bridge [i](a large pipe)[/i].
[previewicon=32720812;sizeThumb,inline;H2_QuarantineZone_04.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

sub_sections.title: ➟ Sacred Icon
sub_sections.description_text:
[table]
[tr]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 1[/b]
From the start of the mission, head towards the first chute. As you come to the raised floor, you’ll find the Golden Moa is atop a ledge to the left of the opening.


[previewicon=32720803;sizeThumb,inline;H2_SacredIcon_01.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 2[/b]
After going down the first two chutes, you’ll reach a passageway. As you enter said passageway, turn left and jump up onto the nearby raised floor. Turn left once more, so that your now face back towards the entry, to find the Golden Moa.
[previewicon=32720804;sizeThumb,inline;H2_SacredIcon_02.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 3[/b]
After a few chutes, you’ll reach a passageway much like where the second Golden Moa was located. Go to the far end of the passageway, before jumping up onto the raised floor to your right. Look to the left, same direction as the exit, to find the Golden Moa.
[i]”Big, scary thing! Run away!” Grunt[/i]
[previewicon=32720805;sizeThumb,inline;H2_SacredIcon_03.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 4[/b]
Once you reach the balcony that looks out over the void in the wall, which you previously crossed on the power source [i](gondola)[/i]. You’ll find the Golden Moa atop a ledge, on the right most column.


[previewicon=32720806;sizeThumb,inline;H2_SacredIcon_04.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 5[/b]
Making your way through the wall, you’ll reach a balcony with a view of the Library [i](it’s the first one, it’s also free of enemies)[/i]. As you drop down from the raised floor, turn left, the Golden Moa will be just out of sight along the wall.
[previewicon=32720807;sizeThumb,inline;H2_SacredIcon_05.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 6[/b]
Once you reach the final area, looking towards the Library, the Golden Moa is on a ledge at the back of the far right pit.


[previewicon=32720808;sizeThumb,inline;H2_SacredIcon_06.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

sub_sections.title: [b]ODST[/b]: 17ᵗʰ September 2026 Weekly Set
sub_sections.description_text:
[b]Tayari Plaza[/b]
[i]Rally Point: [b]Alpha[/b][/i]
[i]Golden Moa [b]2[/b][/i] — From the start of the mission follow the road north past the Wraith, up to the Covenant comm relay, the Golden Moa is in the corner by the dumpster.
[previewimg=29249664;sizeFull,inline;ODST_TayariPlaza_02.jpg][/previewimg]
⠀
[i]Rally Point: [b]Charlie[/b][/i]
[i]Golden Moa [b]4[/b][/i] — After passing the SinoViet fuel truck, go under the foot bridge, the Golden Moa is in the corner to the south east between a building and the sector wall.
[previewimg=29249666;sizeFull,inline;ODST_TayariPlaza_04.jpg][/previewimg]
⠀
[i]Golden Moa [b]5[/b][/i] — Near the Covenant deployable lookout tower, the Golden Moa is in a garden bed beside the truck hauling a Traxus container.
[previewimg=29249667;sizeFull,inline;ODST_TayariPlaza_05.jpg][/previewimg]
⠀
[previewimg=29249451;sizeFull,inline;div02.png][/previewimg]
[b]Uplift Reserve[/b]
[i]Rally Point: [b]Alpha[/b][/i]
[i]Golden Moa [b]4[/b][/i] — East of the large boulders in the middle of Section A is a smaller group of boulders, the Golden Moa is in the grass under the north west side.
[previewimg=29249673;sizeFull,inline;ODST_UpliftReserve_04.jpg][/previewimg]
⠀
[i]Rally Point: [b]Bravo[/b][/i]
[i]Golden Moa [b]6[/b][/i] — The Golden Moa is in on top of a stump in shallow water, as you reach the first group of Shade turrets. [I](north west beach in the Section B)[/i]
[previewimg=29249675;sizeFull,inline;ODST_UpliftReserve_06.jpg][/previewimg]
⠀
[i]Rally Point: [b]Delta[/b][/i]
[i]Golden Moa [b]8[/b][/i] — The Golden Moa is behind the rest/bus stop, near the Spartan Laser, just before the Covenant cargo pad.
[previewimg=29249677;sizeFull,inline;ODST_UpliftReserve_08.jpg][/previewimg]
⠀
[previewimg=29249451;sizeFull,inline;div02.png][/previewimg]
[b]Kizingo Boulevard[/b]
[i]Rally Point: [b]Alpha[/b][/i]
[i]Golden Moa [b]1[/b][/i] — Along the road Mickey is seen running down in the intro cutscene [i](east of spawn)[/i], the Golden Moa is up on a ledge next to the skybridge.
[previewimg=29249678;sizeFull,inline;ODST_KizingoBoulevard_01.jpg][/previewimg]
⠀
[i]Rally Point: [b]Charlie[/b][/i]
[i]Golden Moa [b]2[/b][/i] — The Golden Moa is on top of a beam sticking out of the plaza building that has had a piece of the Mombasa Tether [i](aka: New Mombasa Orbital Elevator)[/i] land on it.
[previewimg=29249679;sizeFull,inline;ODST_KizingoBoulevard_02.jpg][/previewimg]
⠀

sub_sections.title: ➟ The Covenant
sub_sections.description_text:
[i]Rally Point:[/i] [b]Alpha[/b]
[i]Note: Moa's 1 through 8 can be reached from rally point Bravo. Just don't get in a Hornet!
⠀⠀    ⠀Although this requires a lot of backtracking.[/i]
[table]
[tr]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 1[/b]
Half way up the waterfall at the start of the mission.
[previewicon=29301874;sizeThumb,inline;H3_TheCovenant_01.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 2[/b]
Inside the crashed Pelican.
[previewicon=29301875;sizeThumb,inline;H3_TheCovenant_02.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 3[/b]
Next to the shade turret, as you progress up the hill to the first tower.
[previewicon=29301876;sizeThumb,inline;H3_TheCovenant_03.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 4[/b]
On a rock sticking out of the upper half of the waterfall, at the first tower.
[previewicon=29301877;sizeThumb,inline;H3_TheCovenant_04.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 5[/b]
In the lower half of the waterfall, at the first tower, slightly obscured by the water.
[previewicon=29301878;sizeThumb,inline;H3_TheCovenant_05.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 6[/b]
Above the entrance to the first tower.

[previewicon=29301879;sizeThumb,inline;H3_TheCovenant_06.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 7[/b]
On a pillar in the lift room of tower one, as you enter, turn right and follow the outer path [i](anti-clockwise)[/i]. The Moa is on the third pillar to your left.
[previewicon=29301880;sizeThumb,inline;H3_TheCovenant_07.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 8[/b]
On a ledge in the shield control room of tower one, right side of the room, above the Brutes.

[previewicon=29301881;sizeThumb,inline;H3_TheCovenant_08.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

[i]Rally Point:[/i] [b]Bravo[/b]
[i]Note: Moa 10 can be reached from rally point Charlie.[/i]
[table]
[tr]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 9[/b]
On the second tower, the one the Elites visit.

[previewicon=29301882;sizeThumb,inline;H3_TheCovenant_09.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 10[/b]
In a tree stump next to the right AA-Wraith, at the third tower.
[previewicon=29301883;sizeThumb,inline;H3_TheCovenant_10.jpg][/previewicon]
[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]
[b]Golden Moa 11[/b]
